proofs.text: Call `run_breaks()` with the engine `none` and with a real engine standing in; verify both answers carry `engine`, `available`, `reason`, `features` and `log`. Call it with the engine `nosuchengine`; verify no engine module was imported and the reason names it. Have an engine report one rule of two; verify the other is filled in with `attribution: "unavailable"`, and have it report no feature at all; verify every feature the caller named is still listed

rule_text: Every engine answers the same shape, so a caller reads one: an engine name outside the four is not run, a rule the engine never reported is filled in with `attribution: "unavailable"`, and a feature the engine never reached is still listed
